findings.problem: The hint 'have an opinion' doesn't rule out pensar ('Pienso que es buena idea' is also a correct way to give an opinion), so a learner could fairly answer pensar.
findings.fix: hint: have an opinion, as in I think so = ___ que sí (not pensar; the same verb as to believe)

back.es: creer: to believe; to think (have an opinion, suppose), as in creo que sí, I think so

note: irregular: true is defensible because of the preterite creyó/creyeron and creíste, though some grammars call these spelling changes rather than true irregularities.
